verdict.rationale: Pylon's agent 'connectors' documentation states that if a third-party system provides an MCP server, agents can use it directly (falling back to a Custom API tool only when none exists), indicating Pylon can consume external MCP servers as tool sources for its AI agents. However, this is a single thin doc line with no setup walkthrough, supported-server list, or hands-on/runtime confirmation of actually connecting to a third-party MCP server. missing for 10: a dedicated 'add MCP server' configuration flow/UI, documentation of supported transports/auth for third-party servers, and independent or runtime evidence of a working third-party MCP connection.
